# Exemplar Profile: IDP CDK Constructs — Bedrock Step Functions Task Fragment

## Ask / Context

> TODO(interview): inferred from repo analysis only — not yet confirmed by
> the solution architect.

Publish a reusable npm CDK L3 construct that wraps "invoke a Bedrock model
(Claude, image or text) inside a Step Functions IDP pipeline" so downstream
stacks add GenAI extraction as a one-liner task instead of hand-wiring
Lambda + IAM + KMS + Step Functions each time. This is the upstream of the
`.tgz` vendored into idp-portal, and the earlier/experimental ancestor of
the idp-module library. Marked Experimental; single squashed commit.

## Architecture & Why

> TODO(interview): inferred from repo analysis only — not yet confirmed by
> the solution architect.

A single-construct projen/jsii library (~700 authored lines): one
`StateMachineFragment` subclass that provisions a rotated KMS key, encrypted
LogGroup, scoped IAM role, esbuild-bundled Node 22 Lambda, and a
`LambdaInvoke` task.

- **`StateMachineFragment`, not a plain Construct**: exposing
  `startState`/`endStates` lets consumers chain the task directly into any
  Step Functions definition with `.next()` — a cleaner contract than
  exporting a raw Lambda; the org's IDP pipelines are Step-Functions-shaped.
- **Two-tier configuration precedence** is the core design idea: every model
  option (prompt, model ID, tokens, temperature, response shape) can be set
  at synth time via props OR arrive in the runtime Step Functions payload —
  `prop ?? payload ?? default` — so one deployed task serves many document
  types.
- **Tri-shape response**: the handler emits parsed JSON (with a self-healing
  "ask the model to fix its own invalid JSON" retry), an S3 file (via a
  file-type handler map), and raw text simultaneously.
- **jsii packaging discipline**: runtime SDK deps as bundledDependencies,
  aws-cdk-lib/constructs as peers, API.md generated by jsii-docgen, projen
  self-mutation CI guard.

## Key Patterns

- Config precedence chain (stack prop ?? runtime payload ?? default) for
  Step Functions tasks.
- Self-healing JSON output: on parse failure, re-prompt the same model with
  a fix-this-JSON instruction before giving up.
- File-type handler map (`Record<type, {processContent, contentType}>`) with
  `as const` constants deriving the public prop types — extensible dispatch
  over if/else ladders.
- Small IAM statement factories (`getPolicyStatement`) keeping every grant
  uniform and scoped (Bedrock to the exact model ARN, S3 to two buckets).
- Security-by-default resources: KMS rotation, encrypted logs with scoped
  encryption-context conditions, reserved concurrency, optional VPC/SG
  injection.
- Anti-patterns flagged, not imitated: placeholder tests, README/props
  drift (including a wrong package name), a catch-all returning HTTP-style
  500 payloads from an SFN task (silently defeating state-machine error
  handling), and logging base64 image data.
